verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order (eyebrow, headline, body, CTA, legal), but the dark header band is cut off at the left half. The orange divider is stranded on the far right, the body copy and CTA drift right of the headline's axis in a diagonal stagger, and the right third of the canvas is dead space. B gives the headline proper prominence, but it breaks the reading order by dropping 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' to the bottom-left below the headline. It also leaves the logo block and divider isolated, shrinks the CTA until it is weaker than the body copy, splits 'Ships late June' away from the button, and crams the legal text into an unreadable narrow column.
